ops.title: Harden ccnhome before the daemon reads the registry: scan wedge, perms, concurrency, non-UTF-8
ops.description:
Filed 2026-07-30 from the v0.50.0 pre-release audit (4 parallel lenses + a codex
refuter). None of these blocked the tag — the one that did, init's ordering, is
fixed in c56f361 (note 0211a69). These are the survivors, all in
internal/ccnhome, and all worth closing before the daemon starts reading the
registry in Phase D step 4+.

1. scan wedges globally (ccnhome.go:364-374, and see :286, :268). scan returns
   an error for any descriptor read failure that is neither ENOENT nor a decode
   failure. Because RecordWorktree -> releaseWorktree -> List -> scan enumerates
   EVERY registered repository, a single unreadable repo.json — mode 0000 after
   a restore, or owned by another uid — makes `init` and `kg build` fail in every
   other repository on the machine. Fix: record a read failure as corrupt:true so
   List skips it and Reap can collect it; keep the hard error only for ReadDir of
   repos/ itself.

2. dirPerm is 0750 where the signed helper uses 0700 (ccnhome.go:29, :432 vs
   helperclient/fuse_tools.go:71). v0.50.0 has now shipped, so existing trees
   keep 0750 until something migrates them.

3. Unsynchronised read-modify-write (ccnhome.go:249-283, :258, :279, :299).
   Two concurrent registrations can drop a worktree entry. Not reachable from a
   shipped consumer today; it becomes reachable the moment the daemon writes.

4. Non-UTF-8 repo paths never converge (ccnhome.go:271, :276, :435). JSON
   marshalling mangles the bytes, so the round-trip never matches and the
   worktrees list grows by one entry per run. Fix: utf8.ValidString check in
   resolvePath, matching the package's fail-fast posture on a non-exact
   CC_NOTES_HOME at :57.

Also noted, separately actionable: release.yml runs no Go tests in any job, and
its smoke gate never exercises `init` — which is exactly why the ordering
regression reached the tag candidate undetected. Adding `cc-notes init` to the
smoke-macos step would have caught it.

ops.text: an unreadable repo.json under ~/.cc-notes/repos is skipped like a corrupt one, not surfaced as a hard error that wedges every other repo
dirPerm matches the signed helper's 0700 rather than 0750, with existing 0750 trees migrated
the ReadInfo/releaseWorktree/writeInfo read-modify-write is serialised so concurrent registration cannot drop worktree entries
a non-UTF-8 repo path is rejected in resolvePath instead of appending a fresh mangled worktree entry on every run
